notes.title: All updates have concluded for Luvocious.
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30631767/adaf0360d43e15feeb0eff6a56e25b1c24d2ec3e.jpg[/img]
I know that some of you were really excited for the VR aspect of the game. It still is VR compatible in one way or another, however non-VR wise the game is 100 percent playable and works best with an Xbox 360 controller either way. I did try to port this game to Linux, but since it wasn't RPG Maker and had to use a specific version of Unity, I ran into some unforeseeable issues. My lack of a budget prevents me from doing some crazy changes, but for the most part I am satisfied with how Luvocious turned out. It's my one and only 3D game and for what I had planned and worked on with it, it made me happy. I enjoy watching people play the game either on my friends list or on YouTube. Their reactions are priceless and their complaints are often justified or hilarious. Everyone plays my games differently. Some find them really hard, while others find it super easy. Some need a tutorial, while others don't want to even be bothered by a small hint. This game is and has been finished for a long time. So I take a polite and shameful Asian stance as I bow out from further updates on this game mainly on VR, but in general. The dlcs still go to support the future projects of any of my games, but in regards to the ones that have had their updates concluded, not so much anymore. Rest assured, I have done everything in my power and budget to see this game through and it is the second most updated game in my entire catalog. It's one of my favorites next to Rebirth and Falnarion Tactics. 

After watching two of my friends play Luvocious, I had the idea of porting some of the characters into Estellium Legends and they are in the new update. I hope you enjoy seeing them again there and in Solenars Edge Heroes.

As of now, the news portion of Luvocious will be discontinued and if you want future updates on Team Syukino's games I suggest you follow the store page and follow the group. Thank you all for supporting Luvocious before and after it's release. It was a fun journey.

And I apologize again to those who use VR and Linux based systems.

notes.title: No new games from Team Syukino in 2020.
notes.notes:
I decided I won't be making games in 2020. Once I finish my current projects, it's over. People don't want to pay for other people's hard work. I wonder why I am still making the games I do? I don't owe anyone anything. People want this and that for free and they don't care whose life it costs in the process it's really sad. You wouldn't want to go to a 9-5 job every week for free would you? You'd like to be paid doing something you don't really enjoy. I hope you can see my point; buy Indie games. But, people won't buy the games. It's okay because in the end it's the consumer's choice. But if you were able to see the money I made on steam, I guarantee you, you'd quit too. 2 years of being a dev and the total of all the game's sales combined couldn't even buy you a car. Anyways, I'll need to move on to new and better things. I'll be finishing Falnarion Tactics and hopefully my project after that in 2019. But then it's done. This is a solid, concrete choice that I am sure anyone in my position would make.

Thank you and happy holidays.

notes.title: Autumn Sale Begins Today!
notes.notes:
Enjoy most of Team Syukino's products on sale for very cheap starting today till November 27th! Also to explain some recent developments on Falnarion Tactics:
The demo, was a flawed idea and it would have killed my sales in the long run. So to make it better for both the consumer and the developer. I thought it best to make the game early access so I don't turn into a one man skeleton crew for no pay. That way it's fair and I am always devout on my promises to update my games. So with that in mind, the 10 updates needed for the game to release will quickly turn into just 8 and the game will be out before you even know it. I am a person who HATES early access and the stigma behind it is sometimes well-deserved. But, I felt this time around and the only time I felt right in doing this was to do it for this game. I would not do this if it was an RPG maker game. It just felt right doing it this time around. I hope you understand. Also for those who got to download the demo, it should no longer work for you. If you got to play the game, consider yourselves lucky. But in time the content in the now obsolete demo will be quickly overshadowed by the amount of content soon to be available over time in the Early Access. Thank you and have a nice holiday!

https://steamcommunity.com/games/974180
^ If you'd like to join the steam group for FT.

Luvocious update v1.5!

It's been awhile. I hope you have all been well.
I want to start off this post with some good news.
I am finally out of the bank debt. It took awhile, but uh I did it.
I'd like to thank all those who supported me by buying the donations,
dlc and games directly from steam as that was the only way to pay off the debt.
I can now, actually have money from the sales of my games as I haven't recieved
any of it in months because of the debt. This is good. Again, thank you. ^w^

Now on to the update:

-Modern-

-Expanded the town of Shigekatsu and added in
 an entire downtown Shigekatsu to explore.
-Added in Amada Industries. *Can only enter on Saturday*
-Added in the Book Store. *Closed on Sundays and Tuesdays*
-Not adding anymore songs to Alte's laptop, but reminding people
new ones were added in previous updates.
*The game is 100 percent finished and is not in early access.
With that in mind, I've decided not to expand date paths further
as it has nothing to do with the story and there is plenty of
stuff to do in this game as there is. I am very busy and
am working on Falnarion Tactics and other new games
while juggling real life. I am sorry and I hope you will understand.*

-Fantasy-

-Added in the town of Nanako. *Nanako is the seaside town found south of Otestka*
-Added in the town of Colstead. *Colstead can be found past Wingor Creek*
-Added in Alnestia's Shrine. *Alnestia's Shrine is near the Kid's Campsite and Ternesta*
-Added in a hidden goodie in Almachia Castle at the start.
-A bunch of new npcs and hidden goodies to be found all over.
*You can fast travel to both Nanako and Colstead*
-Minor stat changes.

-Futuristic-

-Added in an Ancient Garden on the outskirts of the base in the No Man's Land. *To the East*
-Added in the Feltrox Den.
-Added in the Ancient Cave.
*Both the Feltrox Den and Ancient Cave can be accesed through the Ancient Garden*
-Added in Fantasy Era enemies to the Ancient Areas.

-Other-

-Some U.I. Changes.
-Fixed some grammar.
-VR enhanced some more.
-Some Battle System Tweaks.
-Added in a Item Shop and Traveling Inn Keeper to the Interdimensional Arena.

Keep in mind that from now on the main focus of future updates will be VR.
It will however take some time to do it and will be expensive overtime. Not just
for funds, but for time as well. If you would like to help further the advancement
of this game for that reason. Please keep purchasing the donations or consider
becoming a Patreon. Thats all for now. Thank you very much and happy holidays!

Patreon is here: https://www.patreon.com/TeamSyukino/overview

Long ago, Nerfelo was once a bontiful and thriving world that has remained at peace for hundreds of years. All was beautiful and intact. Peace and tranquility flourished throughout the land. It was heaven. Unfortunately, that only remained until one day when the great Garfarian Empire  came and pillaged the land. In the wake of war, hope was dwindling and all was thought to be lost. The allied Kingdoms of Kessania and Inelda are all that are left to stand in the Garfarian's way. That is, until a rebel group calling themselves the Shelminai emerged.

notes.title: Unfortunately, with things as bad as they are I announce this.
notes.notes: Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn was a game that was in hiatus much longer then the original Solenars Edge Rebirth. Solenars Edge Rebirth was and is received poorly. RPG maker games get a bad rep and the Solenars Edge Series relies on the maker. It unfortunately, for the wrong reasons doesn't get the attention and sales it deserves. Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn would be a project that would spend a minimum of 6 months to be made and 2 months to get paid from. Which could be like Solenars Edge Rebirth. Only around 1000 dollars for the entire year. During this current struggle, I cannot afford to waste time and effort like that. Especially alone and without funding. So, sadly. I will have to prematurely cancel and end production for Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn. Sequels are usually best for highly successful games that usually fund themselves. This is not the case. Either way, I hope you did enjoy and continue to enjoy the Solenars Edge Series. Keep in mind the end of the series is already finished in a 90 page short story book in your game's folder and you also have the in-between after-story DLC. If you want to finish the lore, nothing is stopping you but yourself. I also want to take the time to announce that just because I cancelled one project does not mean I am still not working. I am planning and working on two other games. One is an FPS, another is a secret. I will hopefully announce more details of the projects by the end of the year. Thank you and happy holidays.

A 2D fighting game with anime, video game and etc characters!
-For obvious reasons I cannot resell, but please enjoy this free fighting game recently made for your enjoyment and look forward to other games coming whenever.

Simply download, unzip/unrar and double click the .exe to launch.
Instructions for full screen and config are within the game's folder.

Enjoy!

*Important Info:

I don't have much of a budget and for the most part I would like to make even better games, but I don't have the financial backing and I have lots of other things to deal with. Please note that I will only post the donation link once here and in the game's hub. I do not like asking for donations and they are 100 percent optional. I also do not believe in fake games, over-priced DLCs or unfinished early-access content. So rest assured I always have the customer, not profit in mind when I make anything.

notes.title: Luvocious v1.1 Update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30631767/b9b0f784db4b579befa0888faafa0173f87b8d18.png[/img]



I know that this update has come super early, but I couldn't help but improve the game even more while I still had the motivation! Here you guys go~

Added content:

-Modern-
Added 3 extra songs to Alte's laptop.
Added functionality to the toilet and sink in Alte's Apartment.
Added functionality to the couch in the creator's room in Alte's Apartment.

-Fantasy-
Changed some stats.
Added in the ability to do mining with the crafting table option in the store to craft.
Expanded the City of Almachia.

-Futuristic-
Changed some stats.
Added in some more items.
Introduced different types of Ghosties and Meldara plants to the abandoned basement.

-All-
Added in help signs for all eras.
Fixed functionality in controlls *You can now use your mouse in first person mode to rotate the camera like an fps.*
Added in 8 directional movement.
Added in Luminarus Feather *pictured above* to the rare steam backgrounds *When unlocked, background can be seen on the Artwork tab.*
Made the game as stream safe as possible.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed even more grammar.
Fixed some dialogue where the incorrect characters would show up.
Removed bed functionality in the tutorial as so it doesn't disrupt the process of the tutorial.

*I know that I promised two updates, but I updated this game atleast 10 times since it's launch, so that has to suffice instead.~ The logo is good enough and won't get a rework.*

notes.title: Luvocious is out!
notes.notes:
Please enjoy Luvocious as it is now officially released! I am happy to announce!
Thus concludes Team Syukino's games and I hope these games are enjoyed by many as time passes. Thank you very much! You may now guess your storybook contest answers in the comments below. The winner will be picked on January 25th in a future announcement!

*Please keep in mind to install the custom font inside of Luvocious' folder for a cleaner interface!*

*Storybook Winner was announced on Restoration's page!*

notes.title: Release Date
notes.notes:
The game's development is progressing very smoothly for the most part. I would like to make this announcement to point out that Luvocious' confirmed release date is January 22nd 2018! Happy Holidays! And always, let us go where the world takes us~ Syu-Syu

Check out these other titles by Team Syukino in the mean time:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/679470/Solenars_Edge_Rebirth/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/688380/Restoration/

notes.title: Restoration and Solenars Edge Rebirth Seasonal Sales/Important Info!
notes.notes:
I hope everyone is basking in the glory of the seasonal sales and enjoying the amazing discounts steam-wide. I'd like to remind those interested that Solenars Edge Rebirth and Restoration are both apart of the Seasonal Sales. You can get them both here: http://store.steampowered.com/app/688380/Restoration/ and http://store.steampowered.com/app/679470/Solenars_Edge_Rebirth/
Also make sure to save more during these times with the Sword and Cane Bundle! http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/4321/Sword_and_Cane/

I want to say that although Luvocious isn't a direct prequel to Solenars Edge Rebirth or Restoration. Also in no way shape or form are these games needed to be played before Luvocious. Though it's important to note that some of the lore is tied in Luvocious. Keeping that in mind, it would be strongly suggested you do play these games as well to fully comprehend the jokes and references to the lore within Luvocious. Especially the Fantasy Era which takes place in Alcornagia; the world within Solenars Edge Rebirth.

notes.title: Regarding the brief absense of a Store Page.
notes.notes: Do not be alarmed Luvocious is not cancelled, it just will be going through some minor tweaks as I struggle through this thing called life. I won't ask for donations or support, but please know that this is basically a one man job and the odds are not in my favor. So this is really hard to continue this game, but dispite all that is going on I am trying my best to make sure that one day next year the game does come out.

notes.title: Release Date Pending
notes.notes: The release date has not been pushed back, because it never had a real one to begin with. Luvocious will come out sometime in 2018, but when exactly, we are not sure.
